items: SDFCircleOptions: Configuration options for the analytical [[SDFCircle]] entity.

SDFCircle: An analytical 2D Signed Distance Field (SDF) circle entity powered by [[SDF2D]]. Evaluates the mathematical distance equation directly in the fragment shader with sub-pixel analytical anti-aliasing (`sdAa`), full stroke support, and zero CPU mesh tessellation.
